in_hindi.name: हैसम

historical_references.reference: Haysam ibn Kaladah was a famous poet in the Umayyad period (661-750 AD). He was a native of Kufa in present-day Iraq and is considered one of the foremost poets in the Arabic language. His poetry is characterized by its depth and complexity, and he was known for his mastery of metre, rhyme, and language.
historical_references.context: Famous poet in Iraq, known for his mastery of metre, rhyme, and language.

historical_references.reference: Haysam ibn Matar Al-Qayrawani was a prominent scholar and jurist of the Maliki school of Islamic law in the Fatimid period (909-1171 AD). He was born in Qayrawan in present-day Tunisia. He wrote extensively on various legal issues and is considered one of the leading authorities on Maliki law.
historical_references.context: Prominent scholar and jurist of Maliki school of Islamic law in Tunisia.
